title: Python for engineers
why: Python handles data and calculations too big or repetitive for spreadsheets — sensor logs, survey files, batch calculations — and makes the work repeatable.
what_is_different: Engineering Python uses NumPy/SciPy for numerical methods, pandas for time/depth series, units libraries, and domain file formats (e.g. LAS well logs, CSV from loggers). Results must be traceable and checked against known answers.

extra_modules.title: Domain file formats
extra_modules.outcome: You can: read the files your discipline produces
extra_modules.practice: Load a well log or logger file and plot it

extra_modules.title: Validated calculation tools
extra_modules.outcome: You can: turn a calculation into a tested tool
extra_modules.practice: Package a calculation with tests and a short user guide

starter_project: Automate one recurring engineering analysis from your work: load raw data, run the calculation, plot results and export a report — verified against a hand calculation.
pitfalls: Notebooks no one else can rerun

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
